prompt: Create a 20:9 overscan master for an Earth-region synthesis workshop in Japanese visual novel / JRPG facility CG style. The scene is an old quarry greenhouse and root cellar with dark timber, carved stone benches, moss-covered masonry, exposed roots, dried herbs, reagent bottles, fungal samples, geodes, clay jars, mortar and pestle, brass clamps, stone inlay tools, amber resin lamps, and green-gold leyline veins through a workbench slab. The unnamed adult female artisan is a visual-only candidate NPC: focused, practical, soft anime face, ash-brown work braids, modest long-sleeve cream shirt, moss-green canvas coat, brown leather apron, gloves, tool belt, no exposed chest, shaping a mossy geode or leyline stone with hand tools. Keep her medium-close on the right or center-right, face and core torso safe for a later 1672x941 GUI crop, and preserve left/middle background depth. No text, no UI, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark.
